summary: Phase 3 RadioLife LIVE (livestream commerce) tested end-to-end on both surfaces. Backend: 15/16 pytest passing (93.75%). Web: Go Live → pin product → chat → end + viewer buy (real Stripe cs_test_ URL) all pass. Mobile: same flow works on Expo web preview (host controls, pin, chat, end). Parity confirmed. One minor backend bug found: chat GET ?after=<created_at> does not always exclude the boundary message (BSON ms vs isoformat µs truncation) — causes duplicated messages in the polled chat client. LiveKit is in 'live' mode server-side but no client SDK is bundled — stage placeholder is intentional per PRD.

minor.issue: Filter uses $gt with fromisoformat(after) but Mongo stores datetimes at millisecond precision while API returns microsecond precision → the boundary message ('last seen') is NOT excluded, so the polling client re-appends duplicates every 3s. Fix: either store created_at truncated to ms, or use $gte and pass created_at + 1ms, or dedupe by id client-side. Reference /app/backend/routes/live_commerce.py:229-247.

ui_bugs.issue: On 390x844 the sheet content is not scrolled into view — golive-start / pin-submit render below the visible area of the modal after keyboard/multiline fields; real users must scroll but Playwright normal click errors 'outside viewport'. Consider adding a small maxHeight/height cap + ensure the CTA is always visible above the keyboard. Not blocking (users can scroll).

action_items: Fix chat ?after filter to avoid returning the boundary message (Mongo BSON ms vs iso µs) — either truncate stored created_at, use $gte with epoch+1ms, or dedupe by message id client-side.

(Optional) Make mobile GoLiveSheet / PinProductSheet CTAs always visible — small maxHeight or a sticky bottom CTA so users don't have to scroll to reach 'Start streaming' / 'Pin to show' on smaller phones.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /messages ?after filter compares datetime with microsecond precision to BSON ms-truncated stored value → duplicates leak through to the polling client.
live_commerce.py checkout: origin_url is trusted from body — resolve_origin should be verified to reject arbitrary origins in production (this is handled by core.origins but worth noting).

Only one minor duplicate-message-on-poll issue in chat. LiveKit is in 'live' mode server-side but no client SDK bundled — stage placeholder is expected (do not fail for missing <video>). Stripe checkout returns real cs_test_ URLs when logged in as non-host.
rca of the issue: Chat ?after: routes/live_commerce.py line 236 does `datetime.fromisoformat(after.replace('Z','+00:00'))` on an ISO string that includes microseconds (from Python's datetime.now().isoformat()). Mongo BSON persists datetime at millisecond precision, so the DB-side value < the user-supplied filter, and the query `created_at $gt <after>` returns the boundary message too. Verified by pytest test_post_and_get_messages: assertion `assert 'TEST_host hello' not in texts_after` failed.
